newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian federal spending eased in 10 1996 mths.
newsitem.headline: Belgian federal spending eased in 10 1996 mths.

text.p: Credits taken up for primary spending by the Belgian federal government eased by an inflation-adjusted 0.7 percent to 892.4 billion francs in the 10 months to October, the Budget Ministry said in a statement.
Actual payments with the credits eased by 0.6 percent to 801.0 billion francs in the first nine months. The payments data lag the credit figures by one month.
The statement said the easier trends in the inflation-adjusted primary spending figures shows the efficacity of government policy to keep budget spending in check.
